messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
peranakan_museum | Peranakan Museum | 15 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
skyline_luge | Skyline Luge Sentosa | 30 | 60 | 10:00-21:00 | -
singapore_zoo | Singapore Zoo | 49 | 240 | 08:30-18:00 | -
national_museum | National Museum of Singapore | 15 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
singapore_flyer | Singapore Flyer | 40 | 45 | 10:00-22:00 | -
orchid_garden | National Orchid Garden | 15 | 60 | 08:30-19:00 | -
chinatown_complex | Chinatown Complex Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 07:00-22:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
peranakan_museum: skyline_luge 24, singapore_zoo 43, national_museum 11, singapore_flyer 15, orchid_garden 21, chinatown_complex 14
skyline_luge: peranakan_museum 24, singapore_zoo 52, national_museum 25, singapore_flyer 26, orchid_garden 26, chinatown_complex 21
singapore_zoo: peranakan_museum 43, skyline_luge 52, national_museum 43, singapore_flyer 46, orchid_garden 36, chinatown_complex 46
national_museum: peranakan_museum 11, skyline_luge 25, singapore_zoo 43, singapore_flyer 15, orchid_garden 20, chinatown_complex 15
singapore_flyer: peranakan_museum 15, skyline_luge 26, singapore_zoo 46, national_museum 15, orchid_garden 25, chinatown_complex 16
orchid_garden: peranakan_museum 21, skyline_luge 26, singapore_zoo 36, national_museum 20, singapore_flyer 25, chinatown_complex 21
chinatown_complex: peranakan_museum 14, skyline_luge 21, singapore_zoo 46, national_museum 15, singapore_flyer 16, orchid_garden 21

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

Hey, I’m planning a day out from 10:00 to 13:30. Budget isn't an issue at all. I definitely need to hit up the Peranakan Museum first, followed by the Singapore Flyer. If there’s extra time, I’d also love to check out Skyline Luge Sentosa, Singapore Zoo, National Museum of Singapore, National Orchid Garden, and Chinatown Complex Food Centre.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

# Create Z3 solver
s = Solver()

# Places data
places = {
    "peranakan_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "skyline_luge": {"cost": 30, "dur": 60, "open": 600, "close": 1260},
    "singapore_zoo": {"cost": 49, "dur": 240, "open": 510, "close": 1080},
    "national_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "singapore_flyer": {"cost": 40, "dur": 45, "open": 600, "close": 1320},
    "orchid_garden": {"cost": 15, "dur": 60, "open": 510, "close": 1140},
    "chinatown_complex": {"cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 420, "close": 1320}
}

# Travel times
travel = {
    ("peranakan_museum", "skyline_luge"): 24, ("peranakan_museum", "singapore_zoo"): 43, ("peranakan_museum", "national_museum"): 11, ("peranakan_museum", "singapore_flyer"): 15, ("peranakan_museum", "orchid_garden"): 21, ("peranakan_museum", "chinatown_complex"): 14,
    ("skyline_luge", "peranakan_museum"): 24, ("skyline_luge", "singapore_zoo"): 52, ("skyline_luge", "national_museum"): 25, ("skyline_luge", "singapore_flyer"): 26, ("skyline_luge", "orchid_garden"): 26, ("skyline_luge", "chinatown_complex"): 21,
    ("singapore_zoo", "peranakan_museum"): 43, ("singapore_zoo", "skyline_luge"): 52, ("singapore_zoo", "national_museum"): 43, ("singapore_zoo", "singapore_flyer"): 46, ("singapore_zoo", "orchid_garden"): 36, ("singapore_zoo", "chinatown_complex"): 46,
    ("national_museum", "peranakan_museum"): 11, ("national_museum", "skyline_luge"): 25, ("national_museum", "singapore_zoo"): 43, ("national_museum", "singapore_flyer"): 15, ("national_museum", "orchid_garden"): 20, ("national_museum", "chinatown_complex"): 15,
    ("singapore_flyer", "peranakan_museum"): 15, ("singapore_flyer", "skyline_luge"): 26, ("singapore_flyer", "singapore_zoo"): 46, ("singapore_flyer", "national_museum"): 15, ("singapore_flyer", "orchid_garden"): 25, ("singapore_flyer", "chinatown_complex"): 16,
    ("orchid_garden", "peranakan_museum"): 21, ("orchid_garden", "skyline_luge"): 26, ("orchid_garden", "singapore_zoo"): 36, ("orchid_garden", "national_museum"): 20, ("orchid_garden", "singapore_flyer"): 25, ("orchid_garden", "chinatown_complex"): 21,
    ("chinatown_complex", "peranakan_museum"): 14, ("chinatown_complex", "skyline_luge"): 21, ("chinatown_complex", "singapore_zoo"): 46, ("chinatown_complex", "national_museum"): 15, ("chinatown_complex", "singapore_flyer"): 16, ("chinatown_complex", "orchid_garden"): 21
}

# Variables
day_start = 600  # 10:00
day_end = 810    # 13:30

is_visited = {pid: Bool(f"visited_{pid}") for pid in places}
start_time = {pid: Int(f"start_{pid}") for pid in places}
end_time = {pid: Int(f"end_{pid}") for pid in places}

# Must visit requirements
s.add(is_visited["peranakan_museum"])
s.add(is_visited["singapore_flyer"])

# Constraints per place
for pid, info in places.items():
    dur = info["dur"]
    op = info["open"]
    cl = info["close"]
    
    # Time bounds
    s.add(start_time[pid] >= day_start)
    s.add(end_time[pid] <= day_end)
    
    # If visited
    s.add(Implies(is_visited[pid], And(
        start_time[pid] >= op,
        end_time[pid] <= cl,
        end_time[pid] == start_time[pid] + dur
    )))
    
    # If not visited
    s.add(Implies(Not(is_visited[pid]), And(
        start_time[pid] == day_start,
        end_time[pid] == day_start
    )))

# Order constraint: Peranakan Museum FIRST, followed by Singapore Flyer
s.add(start_time["peranakan_museum"] < start_time["singapore_flyer"])
s.add(end_time["peranakan_museum"] + travel[("peranakan_museum", "singapore_flyer")] <= start_time["singapore_flyer"])

# No overlap and travel time constraints between all pairs of visited places
place_ids = list(places.keys())
for i in range(len(place_ids)):
    for j in range(len(place_ids)):
        if i != j:
            p1 = place_ids[i]
            p2 = place_ids[j]
            t_time = travel[(p1, p2)]
            # If both are visited, p1 must end + travel <= p2 start OR p2 must end + travel <= p1 start
            s.add(Implies(
                And(is_visited[p1], is_visited[p2]),
                Or(
                    end_time[p1] + t_time <= start_time[p2],
                    end_time[p2] + t_time <= start_time[p1]
                )
            ))

# Solve
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    result = []
    for pid in places:
        if is_true(m[is_visited[pid]]):
            result.append({
                "location_id": pid,
                "start": m[start_time[pid]].as_long(),
                "end": m[end_time[pid]].as_long()
            })
    # Sort by start time just to be neat
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
